name: docusense-ai
description: Intelligent document processing and RAG platform monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run typecheck --workspace backend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration --workspace backend && npm run db:verify && npm run indexing:verify && npm run search:verify && npm run rag:verify
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run db:validate && npm run db:status && npm test && npm run rag:evaluate
